The '''Ruhnuk Communications Tower''' was the sole [[communications tower]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]],<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3625 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> At that time, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] rebels known as the [[Hidden Chain]] coalition established a [[Reclaimed Mining Site|base]] on the planet and took control of the abandoned communications tower. During the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]], the Hidden Chain were expelled from the tower and retreated off-world.<ref name="TOR" />
